verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail bundles registered agent service (free with mailbox plans), TruLease for lease-grade compliance addresses, and TruResidence for residency-grade addresses, plus TruStart training that walks through LLC formation — all from the same provider. However, actual LLC formation itself appears to be only educational/self-paced guidance rather than a filed-for-you entity service, so the 'LLC formation' leg of the story is thin. Missing for 10: direct evidence of VPM actually filing/forming the LLC as a service (vs. just teaching how), and independent corroboration of these bundled offerings working together in practice.
